description.en-US: Apps by Sovereign Edge Inc. for GrapheneOS and Pixel. Pocket Agent, a private on-device Claude agent; Pocket Pantry, a pantry, grocery cart and Claude recipes app; and Pocket Concierge, an offline HTML itinerary viewer with Claude.
This app promotes or depends entirely on a non-free network service
AI assistants, chatbots, and large language model (LLM) interfaces

summary.en-US: Offline viewer for self-contained HTML travel itineraries, with Claude

description.en-US:
Pocket Concierge keeps your travel itineraries on the phone as single HTML files and shows them offline.

* Library of itineraries imported with the file picker, "Open with", or Share from Chrome, Drive, Claude or a file manager
* Each itinerary keeps its own checklist progress (localStorage, scoped per file) across restarts; pull down to reload
* Directions links open natively in Google Maps; other links open in their own apps
* Generate with Claude: describe a trip and get a finished itinerary, unlocked once you add your own Claude API key
* Claude connector: an MCP server on the phone that lets Claude Code or the Claude app on your computer list, read, add and revise itineraries over your VPN (Tailscale) or USB, protected by a token
* Follows system dark mode, edge-to-edge

Everything is stored on the phone. The API key and connector token are encrypted with the Android Keystore.

NonFreeNet.en-US: Generating itineraries requires an Anthropic API key; your trip brief is sent to Anthropic's Claude API. Itineraries may load Google Fonts.

summary.en-US: Private on-device Claude agent with memory, skills and automations

description.en-US:
Pocket Agent is a personal assistant that runs on your phone and uses Claude as its model. It is built for GrapheneOS and talks to exactly one server: Anthropic's API.

What it can do, with your permission:
* Read and send SMS, look up contacts, read and add calendar events, read the call log and recent notifications
* Read and write files in a private workspace folder
* Search and read the web
* Read the screen and tap, type and scroll in other apps (accessibility service)
* Remember you across chats (MEMORY.md / USER.md), write reusable skills, and search past chats
* Run scheduled automations that report back in a private notification
* Split research into parallel read-only sub-agents

Anything that sends, taps, types or changes data is shown to you for approval first. Scheduled runs are read-only. The API key is encrypted with the Android Keystore. There are no analytics and no Google Play Services.

You need your own Anthropic API key.

NonFreeNet.en-US: Requires an Anthropic API key. Your prompts and the tool results the agent reads are processed by Anthropic's Claude API.

summary.en-US: Pantry inventory, barcode grocery cart, shopping list and Claude recipes

description.en-US:
Pocket Pantry keeps track of the food in your household and what it costs to replace it. Built for the Pixel 10 Pro and Pro XL.

* Pantry inventory organised by storage location (Pantry, Counter, Fridge, Freezer or your own) with quantities, expiry dates and low-stock warnings
* Cart: pick your grocery store, scan items as they go in the cart and watch the running total with tax. Prices are remembered per store, and finishing a trip can add everything to the pantry
* Shopping list that ticks itself off as you scan, and takes low-stock items or a recipe's missing ingredients in bulk
* Recipes and meal plans from Claude, unlocked once you add your own Claude API key. Claude is told what you have and what is expiring; replies can be saved and their missing ingredients sent to the list
* Light, dark or system theme with Material You colours

Everything is stored on the phone. The API key is encrypted with the Android Keystore. Barcodes are read on-device with ML Kit's bundled model (no Play Services); unknown barcodes are looked up on Open Food Facts and cached.

NonFreeDep.en-US: Barcode scanning uses Google's ML Kit library, which is proprietary (bundled model, no Play Services needed).

NonFreeNet.en-US: Recipes require an Anthropic API key; your prompts and your inventory are sent to Anthropic's Claude API. Unknown barcodes are looked up on Open Food Facts.
